redactions.why: the first, hand-run negative control (2026-09-30, superseded) recorded exception tracebacks from a temporary working copy whose path names the author's home directory. The control is kept unchanged as history; negative_control.py has since used a system temporary directory and records no tracebacks for a clean control.

pytest's junit writer records the build machine's name in each test suite's hostname attribute (found by the series' publication scan, 2026-10-09). The recorded files are not edited; the package shows <host> instead, escaped for XML. The published run (2026-10-04-proof) is shipped byte-exact, as its integrity check requires, so its three junit files keep the name (an author decision, 2026-10-09).

the terminal output of the two runs made before 2026-10-04: lab/build_lab.py printed the absolute path of the Lab it wrote. Fixed at the source (it prints a relative path since); the recorded output is not edited.
